The DSH service continues tasks while you switch apps or turn off the screen. Active tasks keep the processor awake; idle tasks and approval waits release it to save battery.
Disabled. Allow notifications in system settings.

Background questions and approvals produce system notifications. Tap to open the conversation. Eligible text questions can be answered directly; approvals must be handled in DSH. Notifications hide question text.
If the system often ends background tasks, find DeepSeek Harness in system settings and choose unrestricted battery or allow background activity when needed. This may use more battery.
A system force-stop, low memory or device background restrictions can interrupt a request. Saved conversations remain available. Reopening does not automatically replay completed actions.

After you explicitly allow control, DSH can read the current screen and accessibility nodes, tap, swipe, type and go back. Pause at any time in DSH phone settings or its notification. Password fields are not read as text.

Let DSH operate the visible foreground screen and switch to installed apps when needed. Invisible background windows cannot be tapped. Enabling accessibility still requires you to allow this control session in DSH.
Taps and swipes show their location; typing highlights the input field. These hints do not intercept touch. Screenshots wait until the hint disappears.
